title: Stage IV Colon Cancer Thriver
content: Stage IV Colon Cancer ThriverRadical Remission ProjectAug 8, 20241 min readIn 2015 Phil, was diagnosed with stage III colon cancer, followed almost 2 years later with a metastatic diagnosis. After a lobectomy to remove half of his left lung, he refused treatment. He changed his diet and started training as an endurance athlete. For the last 7 years Phil has competed in two 50-mile ultramarathons, one 50-K ultramarathon, 1 marathon, 4 half marathons, and 4 sprint triathlons. After becoming a 2x cancer survivor turned endurance athlete, Phil turned his running into purpose by starting a foundation to raise money for kids who have lost a parent to cancerTo learn more about Phil's Non Profit, visit Running For Dreams or connect with him on Facebook and Instagram.Listen to Phil's story and others like it here.901901 views00 commentsPost not marked as liked
